tips.text: Farm Dante, Onos and Ruvox in the same Armatus session and hold your Vessel Capillaries until the end to fill only the gaps.
Restart after round 3 or 4, or let about 2 conduits fall each round past round 4, to keep drawing from the B table.
Remember a lost conduit is a Demolisher you did not kill; short clean runs balance drops and Capillaries better.
Run Steel Path Armatus if you can handle it; Capillaries per Demolisher more than double.
Run solo; Demolisher health scales with squad size and public squads dilute spawns.
Players report Dante plus both weapons in two to three hours of Armatus, with the Capillary shop covering bad luck.
